The future is bright and tricolor™ About us Privacy Policy Terms of Service Kostanyan, Brodsky explore expanded Armenian-Czech ties On September 4, as part of the Armenian president’s official visit to the Czech Republic, Deputy Foreign Minister Vahan Kostanyan met with Czech Deputy Foreign Minister Jiří Brodský and discussed opportunities to expand bilateral cooperation. The sides also addressed the Armenia-EU strategic partnership agenda and developments in the South Caucasus. Against the backdrop of the dynamic development of friendly relations between the two countries, the importance of reciprocal visits at the highest level was emphasized. The interlocutors identified high technology, artificial intelligence, water resources management, bilateral trade and tourism as promising areas of cooperation, agreeing to continue dialogue in these areas within the framework of intergovernmental commissions. The sides exchanged views on advancing the Armenia-EU strategic partnership agenda, developments in the South Caucasus, as well as a number of international agenda issues of mutual interest.
